title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E16 — The Topaz Connection
A magazine publisher's daughter links her father's murder to a top-secret expose.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E17 — A Nice, Indecent Little Town
Michael and KITT learn a peaceful town's Bible-printing plant harbors counterfeiters.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E6 — Saddled
The paramedics rescue the driver and passengers of a school bus that plunged over a cliff; Gage dreams of becoming a rich rodeo star.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E7 — Fuzz Lady
Gage falls for an overzealous, undercover police officer (Sharon Gless); a series of thefts of equipment plagues Rampart Emergency.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E8 — Trainee
A former Vietnam medic volunteers to train as a paramedic, but his quick diagnoses and independent medical efforts yield disaster.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E9 — Women!
An outspoken, feminist journalist covering the paramedics manages to alienate both the fire department and Rampart Emergency staff.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E10 — Dinner Date
DeSoto maneuvers Gage into a blind date with his wife's cousin; Brackett must operate on a newlywed husband felled by gunshot wounds.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E11 — Musical Mania
Gage's musical efforts irritate Station 51; rescue calls range from frostbite to a man trapped beneath his sliding canyon-home.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E12 — Helpful
An exhausted and emotionally upset woman doctor disappears from the hospital; Gage tries to help DeSoto with a marital difficulty.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E13 — Drivers
An all-star college quarterback collapses suddenly; Gage wants to discipline motorists who fail to yield to fire department vehicles.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E14 — School Days
The paramedics try to boost the confidence of a trainee who has doubts about his readiness to take on emergency duties in the field.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E15 — The Professor
Brackett cares for an ailing foreign dignitary; the paramedics rescue a helicopter pilot, deliver a baby and prevent a suicide jump.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E4 — Fire!
The team helps a fire chief (Stepfanie Kramer) save her one-truck company from takeover by a larger operation.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E5 — Timber!
The team helps brother-and-sister lumberjacks thwart a crooked union boss intent on driving them out of business.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E6 — Double Heat
The team interrupts a war between crime syndicates to rescue a government witness's (Dana Elcar) daughter (Leah Ayres).
